svg.title: The rule needs both halves
svg.desc: A two by two grid. Hidden text with wording that gives an instruction to something other than the reader raises the finding. Hidden text with ordinary wording, such as a marketing preheader, raises nothing, though two preheader phrasings were misread as orders until 31 October 2026. A visible instruction is not caught, which is a stated limit. Visible ordinary wording is ordinary mail. Requiring both halves is a design judgement that has not been measured on a corpus of real mail.
